common.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark theme

auth.tagline: Run the workshop and follow every repair, in one place.
auth.wrongCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.resetEmailSent: If there is an account with that email, we have sent you a link to choose a new password.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your open sessions have been closed.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

validation.number: Enter a whole number within a sensible range.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.intro: {{name}}, you have been invited to work at {{workshop}} with the email {{email}}.
invitation.existingAccountHint: If you already work at another workshop with this email, enter your usual password.

workshop.noWorkshops: Your account has no access to any active workshop. Talk to your workshop's administrator.
workshop.chooseTitle: Which workshop are you working in?

home.comingSoon: The single counter search (plate, name or phone) arrives in the next step.

clients.title: Clients
clients.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, email or tax ID
clients.name: Name or company name
clients.emailOptional: Email (optional, gives access to the portal)
clients.notesHint: Only the workshop staff see them; the client never does.
clients.confirmArchive: Archive {{name}}? They will no longer appear in the list, but nothing is deleted.
clients.noVehicles: They do not own any vehicle.
clients.orders: Work orders they are the client of

worklog.diagnosisHint: Write it for someone who is not a mechanic: it is what the client will see. Each save keeps a version.
worklog.diagnosisChanged: {{name}} saved another version while you were writing. This is theirs:
worklog.keepMine: Keep mine and save it on top
worklog.confirmVoid: Void this work entry? It stays in the list as voided and no longer counts.
worklog.notesHint: Only the workshop staff see them; never the client. They are not edited: they are added.

orders.title: Work orders
orders.noneMine: You are not responsible for any work order.
orders.clientWillBe: The client of the work order will be {{name}}, the vehicle's current owner.
orders.clientHint: The owner of the vehicle when the work order was opened. It does not change if the owner changes.
orders.reason: Reason for the visit (as the client tells it)
orders.droppedOffByName: Dropped off by (if not the owner)
orders.receptionNotesHint: Visible damage, objects left in the car…
orders.noteCancel: Why is it cancelled? (only for work orders opened by mistake)
orders.noteUnrepaired: Why does it leave without being repaired?
orders.confirmUndo: Undo the last change? The work order will go back to “{{status}}” and it will stay in the history.
orders.noQuoteHint: Lets the repair start without an approved quote. The client's waiver needs the signed reception sheet, which arrives later.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.ownerRequired: Choose the owner: a vehicle always has one.
vehicles.changeOwnerHint: Work orders already open stay with the previous owner. The change is recorded in the audit log.

employees.title: Employees
employees.name: Name
employees.confirmRemoveAccess: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in to this workshop. The record is kept. Continue?
employees.invitedNoEmail: Invitation created for {{email}}, but email is not configured and it was not sent.

account.title: My account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been closed.

admin.title: Workshops
admin.created: Workshop created. Its administrator has received the invitation.
admin.createdNoEmail: Workshop created, but email is not configured and the invitation was not sent.
admin.singleInstallation: This is a single-workshop installation and the workshop already exists: no more can be created.
admin.limitOf: Limit of employees with access for {{name}}

superadmins.title: Superadmins
superadmins.inviteHint: They will be able to create workshops, change their limits and read the platform log, but not see what happens inside each workshop. They must use an email that is not an employee's.
superadmins.sentNoEmail: Invitation created, but email is not configured and it was not sent.

superadminInvitation.title: Superadmin invitation
superadminInvitation.intro: You have been invited to administer this AXTTON CORE installation with the email {{email}}. Choose your password to create the account.

portal.comingSoon: The client portal will be available soon.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_input: Some of the data is not valid. Check it, especially the email.
errors.wrong_actor: This account cannot use this part of the application.
errors.workshop_not_found: You do not have access to that workshop.
errors.not_allowed: Your role does not allow this.
errors.last_admin: The workshop needs at least one active administrator with access.
errors.modified_by_someone_else: Someone else changed this in the meantime. We have loaded the latest version: review it and repeat the change.
errors.weak_password: The password is too weak: use at least 10 characters.
errors.invitation_not_found: The invitation does not exist or has expired. Ask for it to be resent.
errors.invitation_already_accepted: This invitation was already accepted. Sign in.
errors.employee_limit_reached: The workshop has reached its limit of employees with access.
errors.already_a_superadmin: This account is already a superadmin. Sign in.
errors.staff_cannot_be_superadmin: That email already belongs to a workshop staff account. A superadmin needs an account of their own, with another email.
errors.superadmin_cannot_be_employee: A superadmin account cannot be an employee of a workshop.
errors.already_an_employee: That account already has access to this workshop with another record.
errors.single_workshop_installation: This is a single-workshop installation and the workshop already exists.
errors.client_not_found: That client does not exist in this workshop.
errors.client_email_taken: Another client of the workshop already has that email. The email gives access to the portal, so it cannot be repeated.
errors.client_archived: That client is archived. Unarchive them before giving them a vehicle.
errors.vehicle_not_found: That vehicle does not exist in this workshop.
errors.vehicle_plate_taken: There is already a vehicle with that plate in the workshop.
errors.vehicle_vin_taken: There is already a vehicle with that VIN in the workshop. It may be the same car registered with another plate.
errors.invalid_plate: The plate can only have letters and numbers (spaces and hyphens are removed automatically).
errors.invalid_vin: The VIN can only have letters and numbers, up to 17.
errors.work_order_not_found: That work order does not exist in this workshop.
errors.work_order_closed: The work order is closed: it only accepts internal notes and its payment.
errors.warranty_of_not_delivered: A warranty work order can only come from a work order already delivered.
errors.warranty_of_requires_warranty_type: Only a warranty work order can link to the original work order.
errors.invalid_transition: The work order cannot move to that status from the current one.
errors.no_quote_reason_required: To repair without an approved quote, first mark the work order as “no quote”.
errors.note_required: Explain why: it is required for this change.
errors.cannot_undo_automatic: The last change was not made by hand (or is already an undo), so it cannot be undone.
errors.cannot_undo_notified: The last change already notified the client and cannot be undone.
errors.cannot_undo_closing: A delivered or cancelled work order is not reopened.
errors.no_quote_not_now: “No quote” can only be set before the repair starts.
errors.waiver_requires_signed_reception: The client's waiver needs the signed reception sheet.
errors.work_order_has_work: The work order has recorded work: it cannot be cancelled. Void the entries if they were recorded by mistake.
errors.work_entry_not_found: That work entry does not exist in this work order.
errors.work_entry_already_voided: That work entry was already voided.
